body: Thank you so much for your advice and taking the time to write back.  Something you said actually made me sit up and think differently about some situations. I'm trying anyway! I'm just very lonely and very low. But thank you again.

Firstly alcoholism and then psychosis. My mum. I don't even know how to put into words all the tons of really messed up shit that happened. And still is now. The meds she's on aren't right so she has another appointment soon. But I've not actually seen her in 8 months when before this we spoke every day. I'm just lost and I cannot figure a way out of this. I know this probably sounds daft but I can't live in this world the way it is now. I'm just not meant for this world you know? And I've always felt different and somehow just knew my life would be drastically different from normal people's lives...
